notes: ACS figures are estimates, not exact counts.
Derived rates use Census table denominators listed in the metric configuration.

Margins of error are included for direct estimates where published. Derived-rate margins of error are not calculated in this first implementation; numerator and denominator values are preserved for review.
Block-group estimates can have high uncertainty. Treat small-area values as directional, especially when denominators are small.
